notes.title: The Creature Zone VR: Welcome To Dystopia Update 2.1 Notes
notes.notes:
yeah, this is the final update...
until the meta app lab port is done!
while there will be an absence on the pcvr end, we will work on the meta quest app lab port.
without further of do, here is The Creature Zone VR: Welcome To Dystopia Update 2.1 Notes:

~ fixed a bug where enemies didn't bleed outside of the infinite arena mode
~ removed the static effect on barriers
~ fixed issues with player not bleeding
~ added a blood decal.
~ the dropping mechanic will now be available in the campaign
~ removed foot ik because it is unnecessary to add for such a short experience

thanks for playing!
-derrick does gaming, developer of this game.

notes.title: The Creature Zone VR: Welcome To Dystopia Update 2.0 "Let's Get Ready To Rumble"
notes.notes:
The Creature Zone VR: Welcome To Dystopia Update 2.0 "Let's Get Ready To Rumble" Notes:
~ NEW: The Infinity Arena! this gamemode is an arena-style shooter, but there is no time or enemy spawn limit. enemies will keep spawning until you die.
~ Fixed the Creature Ai Bugs In The Science Lab Level.
~ Improved The Blood Effects Of The Guards.
~ Added A Trippy Plane In The Sandbox Level.
Thanks For Playing!
-Derrick Does Gaming, Dev Of This Game.
